answer.reason: The site's main navigation is driven by the Header content item (model: Header), whose "Navigation" field is a nested Linked Content grid pointing to the TopLevelNav content model (id 13, referenceName "TopLevelNav"). Each item in that list represents one top-level menu entry (a Link field, plus optional Sub-Nav links built from the NavLink model, and optional bottom links). Since 'Docs' is a new top-level item in the main nav menu, it should be created as a new TopLevelNav content item (linked into the Header's Navigation field), not a NavLink (which is for sub-nav items) or the Header/Footer models themselves (which are singleton containers, not per-link content).
